title.lg: Ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula YA BWEREERE
title.sw: Barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 ni BURE

answer.en: The LC1 introductory letter (for passport, NIRA registration and similar needs) costs 0 UGX. It is free by law everywhere in Uganda. If anyone asks you to pay, refuse and report them to LC2.
answer.lg: Ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula (eya pasipooti, okuwandiisa NIRA n'ebirala) ya UGX 0. Ya bwereere ng'etteeka bwe ligamba wonna mu Uganda. Omuntu yenna akusaba osasule, gaana era mumanyise ku LC2.
answer.sw: Barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 (ya pasipoti, usajili wa NIRA na mahitaji kama hayo) ni UGX 0. Ni bure kisheria kote Uganda. Mtu yeyote akikudai ulipe, kataa na umrripoti kwa LC2.

illegal_practices.en: Charging any fee for an LC1 introductory letter is illegal. Report to LC2 or LC3 with the name of the person who asked for money.
illegal_practices.lg: Okusasuza ssente zonna ku bbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula kimenya mateeka. Tegeeza ku LC2 oba LC3 ng'olina erinnya ly'eyakusaba ssente.
illegal_practices.sw: Kutoza ada yoyote kwa barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 ni kinyume cha sheria. Ripoti kwa LC2 au LC3 ukiwa na jina la aliyedai pesa.

en: Go to your LC1 with your ID or a witness who knows you
Ask for the introductory letter and state its purpose
Collect it the same day; do not pay anything
lg: Genda ku LC1 yo ng'olina ID yo oba omujulizi akumanyi
Saba ebbaluwa eya kwanjula era otegeeze ky'ogenda okugikozesa
Gigye olunaku olwo; tosasa kintu kyonna
sw: Nenda LC1 yako na kitambulisho chako au shahidi anayekujua
Omba barua ya utambulisho na ueleze matumizi yake
Ichukue siku hiyo hiyo; usilipe chochote

question.en: Did you know? The LC1 letter for passport or NIRA is free.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya pasipooti oba NIRA ya bwereere.
question.sw: Ulijua? Barua ya LC1 ya pasipoti au NIRA ni bure.

answer.en: Yes. 0 UGX by law. Anyone charging you is breaking the law.
answer.lg: Yee. UGX 0 ng'etteeka bwe ligamba. Akusasuza amenya mateeka.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. UGX 0 kisheria. Anayekutoza anavunja sheria.

title.en: LC1 stamp on private documents: 10,000 UGX
title.lg: Sitampu ya LC1 ku bbaluwa zo: UGX 10,000
title.sw: Muhuri wa LC1 kwenye nyaraka zako: UGX 10,000

answer.en: The LC1 stamp on private documents (sale agreements, declarations) costs a flat 10,000 UGX everywhere in Uganda. It is never a percentage of the deal. Pay at the LC1 office and always get a receipt.
answer.lg: Sitampu ya LC1 ku bbaluwa zo (endagaano z'okutunda, ekirayiro) ya UGX 10,000 zokka wonna mu Uganda. Tekiba kitundu ku muwendo gw'ensonga. Sasira ku offiisi ya LC1 era bulijjo funa risiti.
answer.sw: Muhuri wa LC1 kwenye nyaraka zako (mikataba ya mauzo, viapo) ni UGX 10,000 taslimu kote Uganda. Kamwe si asilimia ya muamala. Lipia ofisi ya LC1 na kila wakati pata risiti.

illegal_practices.en: Demanding a percentage of the sale price for the stamp is extortion. The fee is fixed at 10,000 UGX. Report overcharging to LC2.
illegal_practices.lg: Okusaba ekitundu ku muwendo gw'okutunda ku sitampu kwe kutunza bubbi. Ssente nnyiriri: UGX 10,000. Abasasula ennyo bategeeze ku LC2.
illegal_practices.sw: Kudai asilimia ya bei ya mauzo kwa muhuri ni unyang'anyi. Ada ni thabiti: UGX 10,000. Ripoti wanaotoza zaidi kwa LC2.

en: Bring your signed document to the LC1 office
Pay exactly 10,000 UGX and get a receipt
Check the stamp carries the LC1 name, date and signature
lg: Leeta ebbaluwa yo eriko omukono ku offiisi ya LC1
Sasula UGX 10,000 zokka era ofune risiti
Kebera sitampu ng'eriko erinnya lya LC1, olunaku n'omukono
sw: Leta waraka wako uliosainiwa ofisi ya LC1
Lipa UGX 10,000 kamili na upate risiti
Hakikisha muhuri una jina la LC1, tarehe na sahihi

question.en: Did you know? The LC1 stamp fee is 10,000 UGX by law. If you are asked to pay more, it is not legal.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Ssente za sitampu ya LC1 UGX 10,000 ng'etteeka bwe ligamba. Bw'osabibwa osasule ennyo, tekiri mu mateeka.
question.sw: Ulijua? Ada ya muhuri wa LC1 ni UGX 10,000 kisheria. Ukidaiwa kulipa zaidi, si halali.

answer.en: True. Flat 10,000 UGX, receipted. Report anyone charging more.
answer.lg: Mazima. UGX 10,000 nnyiriri, ne risiti. Tegeeza omuntu yenna akusasuza ennyo.
answer.sw: Kweli. UGX 10,000 taslimu, na risiti. Ripoti mtu yeyote anayetoza zaidi.

title.lg: Okutegeeza ku Poliisi omulundi ogusooka KWA BWEREERE
title.sw: Ripoti ya kwanza polisi ni BURE

answer.en: Making your first report at any Police station costs 0 UGX. It is free. You will get a case reference number. If an officer asks for money to open your case, ask for their name and report to the District Police Commander.
answer.lg: Okutegeeza omusango gwo ku sitenseni yonna eya Poliisi kwa bwereere: UGX 0. Ojja kufuna namba ya fayiro yo. Omuserikale bw'akusaba ssente okuggulawo omusango gwo, musabe erinnya lye era mumanyise ku District Police Commander.
answer.sw: Kutoa taarifa yako ya kwanza kituo chochote cha Polisi ni bure: UGX 0. Utapata namba ya kumbukumbu ya kesi yako. Afisa akikudai pesa kufungua kesi yako, muulize jina lake na umrripoti kwa Kamanda wa Polisi wa Wilaya.

legal_citation: Police Standing Orders; Constitution of Uganda Art. 212

illegal_practices.en: No officer may charge to record your statement or open a case file. Demanding fuel money or airtime to investigate is also illegal.
illegal_practices.lg: Tewali muserikale akkirizibwa kusasuza kuwandiika kiwandiiko kyo oba okuggulawo fayiro. Okusaba ssente za mafuta oba airtime okunoonyereza nakyo kimenya mateeka.
illegal_practices.sw: Hakuna afisa anayeruhusiwa kutoza kuandika maelezo yako au kufungua jalada. Kudai pesa za mafuta au vocha kuchunguza pia ni kinyume cha sheria.

en: Go to the nearest Police station with your ID
Give your statement and get the reference number
Follow up with the investigating officer using that number
lg: Genda ku sitenseni ya Poliisi erisinga okumpi ng'olina ID yo
Wa kiwandiiko kyo era ofune namba ya fayiro
Buuza ku muserikale anoonya ng'okozesa namba eyo
sw: Nenda kituo cha Polisi kilicho karibu na kitambulisho chako
Toa maelezo yako na upate namba ya kumbukumbu
Fuatilia na afisa anayechunguza kwa kutumia namba hiyo

question.en: Did you know? Reporting a crime to Police is free.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Okutegeeza omusango ku Poliisi kwa bwereere.
question.sw: Ulijua? Kuripoti jinai kwa Polisi ni bure.

answer.en: Yes. First report costs 0 UGX. Always get your reference number.
answer.lg: Yee. Okutegeeza okusooka kwa UGX 0. Bulijjo funa namba ya fayiro yo.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Taarifa ya kwanza ni UGX 0. Kila wakati pata namba yako ya kumbukumbu.

title.sw: Usajili wa kitambulisho cha taifa ni BURE

answer.en: First-time national ID registration at NIRA costs 0 UGX. It is free. Bring your LC1 introductory letter and a parent's or guardian's ID if you have one. Do not pay agents hanging around NIRA offices.
answer.lg: Okuwandiisa ID ey'eggwanga omulundi ogusooka ku NIRA kwa bwereere: UGX 0. Leeta ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula ne ID ya muzadde oba omukuza bwe ggibaayo. Tosasa bakayaaya abeeranga ku offiisi za NIRA.
answer.sw: Usajili wa kwanza wa kitambulisho cha taifa NIRA ni bure: UGX 0. Leta barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 na kitambulisho cha mzazi au mlezi kama unacho. Usilipe mawakala wanaozunguka ofisi za NIRA.

illegal_practices.en: Agents who charge to fast-track your ID are conmen. NIRA serves people in order and registration is free. Report touts to NIRA staff or Police.
illegal_practices.lg: Bakayaaya abasasuza okwanguyiza ID yo bafere. NIRA eweereza abantu ng'enkola bw'eri era okuwandiisa kwa bwereere. Abakuyigganya bategeeze ku bakozi ba NIRA oba ku Poliisi.
illegal_practices.sw: Mawakala wanaotoza kuharakisha kitambulisho chako ni matapeli. NIRA huhudumia watu kwa zamu na usajili ni bure. Ripoti wahuni kwa wafanyakazi wa NIRA au Polisi.

en: Get your free LC1 introductory letter
Go to the nearest NIRA centre with your documents
Give biometrics and keep the registration slip safe
lg: Funa ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula ya bwereere
Genda ku NIRA erisinga okumpi ng'olina ebbaluwa zo
Wa biometrics era okwate akapapula k'okuwandiisa
sw: Pata barua ya bure ya utambulisho ya LC1
Nenda kituo cha NIRA kilicho karibu na nyaraka zako
Toa biometriki na uhifadhi stakabadhi ya usajili

question.en: Did you know? Your first national ID is free at NIRA.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? ID yo ey'eggwanga ey'olubereberye ya bwereere ku NIRA.
question.sw: Ulijua? Kitambulisho chako cha kwanza cha taifa ni bure NIRA.

answer.en: Yes. 0 UGX. Never pay agents around NIRA offices.
answer.lg: Yee. UGX 0. Tosasa bakayaaya abeeranga ku offiisi za NIRA.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. UGX 0. Usilipe mawakala wanaozunguka ofisi za NIRA.

answer.en: A Ugandan passport application costs 250,000 UGX, paid officially at the bank or online through the Ministry of Internal Affairs portal. You need your national ID, LC1 letter and birth certificate. Apply yourself. Middlemen cannot speed it up.
answer.lg: Okusaba pasipooti ya Uganda kwa UGX 250,000, ezisasulwa mu bbanka oba online ng'oyita ku portal ya Ministry of Internal Affairs. Weetaaga ID yo ey'eggwanga, ebbaluwa ya LC1 ne birth certificate. Wesabire wekka. Abakayaaya tebayinza kukwanguyiza.
answer.sw: Maombi ya pasipoti ya Uganda ni UGX 250,000, zinazolipwa rasmi benki au mtandaoni kupitia tovuti ya Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani. Unahitaji kitambulisho chako cha taifa, barua ya LC1 na cheti cha kuzaliwa. Jitume mwenyewe. Mawakala hawawezi kukuharakishia.

legal_citation: Uganda Citizenship and Immigration Control Act

illegal_practices.en: Anyone promising a passport in days for extra cash is lying. Pay only the official 250,000 UGX through proper channels and keep the payment slip.
illegal_practices.lg: Asuubiza pasipooti mu nnaku ntono ku ssente endala akulimba. Sasula UGX 250,000 zokka ng'oyita mu ngeri entuufu era okwate akapapula k'okusasula.
illegal_practices.sw: Anayeahidi pasipoti ndani ya siku kwa pesa za ziada anakudanganya. Lipa UGX 250,000 pekee kupitia njia rasmi na uhifadhi stakabadhi ya malipo.

en: Get your national ID, LC1 letter and birth certificate ready
Fill the form on the immigration portal and pay 250,000 UGX
Book your interview date and keep the payment slip
lg: Tegeka ID yo ey'eggwanga, ebbaluwa ya LC1 ne birth certificate
Jjuza foomu ku portal y'ekitongole ky'ebyabagenyi era osasule UGX 250,000
Teekawo olunaku lw'okubuuza era okwate akapapula k'okusasula
sw: Andaa kitambulisho chako cha taifa, barua ya LC1 na cheti cha kuzaliwa
Jaza fomu kwenye tovuti ya uhamiaji na ulipe UGX 250,000
Weka tarehe ya mahojiano na uhifadhi stakabadhi ya malipo

verified_by.name: AC Verification Desk
verified_by.source_document: Uganda Citizenship and Immigration Control Act

question.en: Did you know? A passport costs 250,000 UGX paid officially. No agent needed.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Pasipooti ya UGX 250,000 ezisasulwa mu ngeri entuufu. Toweetaaga mukayaaya.
question.sw: Ulijua? Pasipoti ni UGX 250,000 zinazolipwa rasmi. Huhitaji wakala.

answer.en: True. Apply yourself on the immigration portal and keep your slip.
answer.lg: Mazima. Wesabire wekka ku portal era okwate akapapula ko.
answer.sw: Kweli. Jitume mwenyewe kwenye tovuti na uhifadhi stakabadhi yako.

flashcard.source: Uganda Citizenship and Immigration Control Act

answer.en: A birth certificate for citizens costs UGX 5,000 at NIRA. Bring the hospital birth notification and the parents' IDs. Register your child early. It unlocks school, ID and passport later.
answer.lg: Birth certificate eri bannansi ya UGX 5,000 ku NIRA. Leeta ebbaluwa y'eddwaaliro ey'okuzaalibwa ne ID za bazadde. Wandiisa omwana wo mangu. Eggulawo essomero, ID ne pasipooti mu maaso.
answer.sw: Cheti cha kuzaliwa kwa raia ni UGX 5,000 NIRA. Leta taarifa ya kuzaliwa ya hospitali na vitambulisho vya wazazi. Msajili mwanao mapema. Hufungua shule, kitambulisho na pasipoti baadaye.

illegal_practices.en: Hospitals must not hold your baby or documents over unpaid bills beyond the law, and touts must not charge for a 5,000 UGX certificate. Report both to NIRA or Police.
illegal_practices.lg: Amalwaliro tegakkirizibwa kukwata mwana wo oba ebbaluwa zo olw'ebbanja, era bakayaaya tebakirizibwa kusasuza ku chipuli kya UGX 5,000. Bategeeze ku NIRA oba ku Poliisi.
illegal_practices.sw: Hospitali hazipaswi kushika mtoto wako au nyaraka zako kwa sababu ya bili, wala wahuni kutoza kwa cheti cha UGX 5,000. Ripoti wote kwa NIRA au Polisi.

en: Get the birth notification from the hospital
Take it with parents' IDs to the nearest NIRA centre
Pay 5,000 UGX officially and keep the receipt
lg: Funa ebbaluwa ey'okuzaalibwa okuva mu ddwaaliro
Gitwale ne ID za bazadde ku NIRA erisinga okumpi
Sasula UGX 5,000 mu ngeri entuufu era okwate risiti
sw: Pata taarifa ya kuzaliwa kutoka hospitali
Ipeleke na vitambulisho vya wazazi kituo cha NIRA kilicho karibu
Lipa UGX 5,000 rasmi na uhifadhi risiti

question.en: Did you know? A birth certificate costs only 5,000 UGX.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Birth certificate ya UGX 5,000 zokka.
question.sw: Ulijua? Cheti cha kuzaliwa ni UGX 5,000 tu.

answer.en: Yes. Register early at NIRA with the hospital notification.
answer.lg: Yee. Wandiisa mangu ku NIRA ng'olina ebbaluwa y'eddwaaliro.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Sajili mapema NIRA ukiwa na taarifa ya hospitali.
